note: Reasoned exemptions from the root slot contract (`ui-cli check data-slots`). Each entry waives one rule for one component and states why. An entry that stops matching a real defect fails the check as a stale exception, so the list can only shrink by fixing the component.

exceptions.reason: Two roots with names of their own by design: `avatar-identity` for the single identity and `avatar-pair` for the overlapping pair. Both names are selected from outside the component (the dropdown highlight rule in inputs/menus.tsx, the Avatar stories and the surfaces e2e spec), so collapsing them into a single `avatar` root would break those consumers and lose the distinction between the two appearances.

The stamp is on the root, but the root is not in this file: the markup lives in the internal `PictogramFigure`, which stamps `data-slot="pago-pa-pictogram"` and which `PagoPAPictogram` renders after resolving the name it was given. The shared figure is what lets the built-in components draw one known illustration without importing the whole pictogram catalogue, so the delegation is the point of the split rather than an oversight; the gate reads a component's own returned expression and reaches the figure only one level down from a host element, not through a component it renders.
